data.body: The taxonomy registry is the site’s curated vocabulary: categories and tags agents may use. Content referencing an unknown term fails validation instead of minting vocabulary by accident.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • kinds (required)

Patch operations

  • add_term
  • update_term
  • deprecate_term
  • reactivate_term
  • remove_term
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.
